channel.description: Reserve Bank of India – Press Releases

item.title: RBI issues updated guidelines on Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI)
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India today issued revised guidelines on Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI) covering KYC requirements, interoperability mandates, and onboarding procedures for banks and non-banks operating under the AD II licence framework.

item.title: NPCI reports record UPI transaction volume in April 2025
item.description: The National Payments Corporation of India announced that UPI transactions reached an all-time high of 14 billion in April 2025, reflecting strong adoption across merchant and P2P segments.

item.title: Reserve Bank releases Annual Report 2023-24
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India today released its Annual Report for the year 2023-24.

item.title: Bollywood actor appointed as financial literacy ambassador
item.description: A popular Bollywood actor has been appointed as the financial literacy ambassador by a major bank.
